description: Small Ralph self-iteration for the current branch. There is no PR or GitHub Actions run for this branch yet, and no PR CI auto-fix context was appended to progress. Local health probes passed (`go test ./...`, `npm --prefix web test -- --run`, `npm --prefix web run build`). Previously known fresh-CI risks around embedded WebUI assets and US-453 streamless binary downloads are already covered. The highest-value remaining OSv2 upper-layer gap is Browser Live mode reliability: the UI enables WebSocket live updates while the SSE object-set fallback path is effectively unreachable and the live indicator is tied to operator intent rather than transport state.

userStories.name: Make Browser Live fall back to SSE truthfully
userStories.description: Wire Browser Live mode so a failed WebSocket subscription can activate the existing temporary ObjectSet SSE subscription, and ensure the UI/tests distinguish a requested live mode from an actual connected transport path.
bdd_acceptance: Given Browser Live mode is enabled and the WebSocket subscription reports a transport failure, When a temporary ObjectSet RID is available, Then BrowserPage enables the SSE subscription for that RID instead of leaving the fallback unreachable.
Given Browser Live mode is enabled and WebSocket remains connected, When the temporary ObjectSet RID is created, Then BrowserPage keeps SSE disabled so it does not duplicate invalidations.
Given the SSE fallback receives an object-set event, When BrowserPage handles the event, Then it invalidates the canonical `objects` TanStack Query cache just like the WebSocket path.

userStories.name: Add event-driven Browser realtime Playwright gate
userStories.description: Replace the skipped timing-sensitive Browser realtime Playwright assertion with an event-driven gate that observes the subscription stream and then verifies a deterministic table refresh condition.
bdd_acceptance: Given the Northwind E2E seed exposes the `createCustomer` action, When Browser Live is enabled and the action is applied, Then the test waits on a subscription event rather than polling a row before the event arrives.

Given the customer table has accumulated more than one page of rows from earlier specs, When the realtime test inserts a fresh customer, Then the assertion navigates or queries deterministically so the new object is visible.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the Browser realtime spec is parsed, Then the previously skipped realtime scenario is discoverable without relying on a live backend.
quality_gates: `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list phase7/browser-realtime-mode.spec.ts phase7/sse-reconnect.spec.ts`

userStories.name: Expose Browser Live reconnect status
userStories.description: Surface Browser Live transport status in the page chrome so operators can see whether live updates are connected, reconnecting, or disabled while Time Travel is active.
bdd_acceptance: Given Browser Live is connected over WebSocket or SSE, When the operator views the Browser toolbar, Then the status indicator exposes connected state with accessible text.
Given the active live transport is reconnecting, When the hook reports reconnecting status, Then the Browser toolbar no longer presents the same connected indicator.
Given Time Travel is active, When the operator views Browser Live controls, Then the disabled status explains that live updates are unavailable for historical snapshots.
